entries.name: bv2-tree-v2-reject#0
entries.description: Block version 2, activated 1. The spent box's tree is v2 (0a 02 08 d3), above it. checkSoftForkCondition compares below activated 2 as well (Interpreter.scala:321-328): 'ErgoTree version 2 is higher than activated 1', invalid. The fork over-accepts. The input spends a box of value 1000000000 into one plain output of the same value, with no proof. The block version sets the activated version to (blockVersion - 1).toByte (ergo ErgoContext), and checkSoftForkCondition compares Bytes. Above the max supported script version (3) a tree above v3 is accepted unverified at the initial cost alone (12100) — its proposition is not reduced.

expected.reason: org.ergoplatform.validation.MalformedModifierError: Scripts of all transaction inputs should pass verification. eb4076b72918f18d141f7973360e91a5222a60f6b3127367318fb683d832b11e: #0 => Failure(sigma.exceptions.InterpreterException: ErgoTree version 2 is higher than activated 1)
